ActionBinding.description:
One declared mutation: a host action primitive, the reader binding whose kind it acts on, the arguments that fix what it writes, and what must be true of the object before it is written.

#551 is what moves the Flux and Argo CD actions in core into manifests that use these.

arguments.description: What this action writes, fixed at install time.

availableWhen.description:
What must be true of the object for the control to be offered. The same predicates, asked by the surface rather than by the cluster request, so a person is not shown a button whose refusal is already known.

Display only, and deliberately so: an app that needs a condition *enforced* declares it in `preconditions`, where the host is what checks it. A surface can be out of date; the fresh GET cannot.

preconditions.description:
What must be true of the object for the write to be sent. Evaluated by the host against the fresh GET the primitive already performs, before the patch; a predicate that does not hold refuses the request and the operator is told this predicate's `reason`.

These add refusals. The host's own guards — an object being deleted, a UID or `resourceVersion` that has moved — run first and are not something a manifest can reach.

resource.description: The name of a reader binding in `capabilities`. The action acts on that binding's kind and on no other.

DetailLink.description: An entry in a resource detail view's app links menu that opens a read-only results panel. It never writes to the cluster; the name `rowActions` is reserved for declared mutations.

ManifestKind.description: Only data is executable in this first host. Code-bearing manifests must go through the future sandboxed runtime, never through a permissive fallback.

Predicate.description:
One declared check about the object an action would write.

Exactly one operator per predicate:

```json {"jsonPath": ".spec.suspend", "notEquals": true, "reason": "Resume this resource before requesting reconciliation"} ```

absent.description: `true`: the value at `jsonPath` must be unset or null.

equals.description: The value at `jsonPath` must equal this literal.

jsonPath.description: The value this predicate asks about, as a bounded JSONPath subset: `.spec.suspend`, `.metadata.annotations['acme.io/pinned']`, `.status.conditions[0].status`. The grammar is the bounded subset the module documents: no wildcard, filter or recursive descent.

notEquals.description: The value at `jsonPath` must not equal this literal. An unset field is not equal to anything, so this holds when it is absent.

present.description: `true`: the value at `jsonPath` must be set and not null.

reason.description: What the operator is told when this predicate does not hold. Untrusted display text: written by the app, and escaped by the host before anything draws it.

$schema.description: Editor metadata: the JSON Schema the manifest is written against. The host ignores it; it is the one key allowed that is not part of the contract.

actions.description: Declared mutations (#549). Absent in a manifest that only reads, and left out of the serialized form when empty so a manifest stored and signed without it still round-trips to its own bytes.
